notes.title: Speedrun Update
notes.content: Dear speed runners, we've patched all of your sneaky tricks. But we have a new challenge for you, whoever has the fastest start to finish speed run time by this Thursday will have their name permanently immortalized on a plaque in the main lobby of Finding Frankie. ALL submissions must be recorded and posted to Youtube with a timer or external one visible. The timer begins when loaded into the game, and ends when the title card appears. You MUST use the latest build and include "Speedrun" in the video title. Happy running!

notes.title: Finding Frankie OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Finding Frankie has officially released on Steam! We hope you've sharpened your parkour skills! 

Hey everyone, we made it! Finding Frankie is released! We want to thank you all for the tremendous support you've shown us over the past two years. We truly can't wait for you to get your hands on the game tomorrow! We've poured our hearts and souls into this project and are beyond grateful for the incredible support and response the game has received so far. We hope you've sharpened your parkour skills—you'll need them!

Consider joining our Discord if you like the game! https://discord.gg/n3KwGN8dF7
